why: Make shared room context readable on the native Echo display while preserving human settings and foreground owners.

authorization.source: Blake October 26 request, relayed by commissioning owner to echo_live_presentation
allowed: Implement and test a native Echo context slice
notAuthorized: Deploy or connect to live Echo
Alter HA, Pixel, capture, audio or shared services

brief.audience: People sharing the room; no private/adult/child identity grants
brief.task: Read one current shared-context paragraph, then return to the existing conversation or clock
brief.destination: TECHO5 native Show framebuffer renderer in NerveOS fork
brief.contentSource: Synthetic shared-room text only; production trusted operator writer is not connected
designDecisions: Explicit NervOS palette preset uses NerveTheme Slate #293b46, Cloud #edf0ed, Signal #91a99a; current human theme and custom colors remain authoritative
NervOS Home type-first paragraph; 40px outer margin, 42px body, 26px explanation
Four body lines and two explanation lines; preserve human font and yield if it does not fit
Stable silent surface; no Presence timing/audio or capture changes
Explicit existing Clock style choice plus separate trusted operator binding
assumptions: Room viewing distance and physical contrast acceptance unverified
Actual transport and operator enrollment need separate commissioning

tiers.name: native-preview
tiers.trigger: Native Go renderer can cross-compile for isolated Linux test host
retainedRequirements: Strict scoped expiry and revision handling
validationRequired: Run rejection, atomic revision, expiry and manual-choice tests
Cross-compile ARM target and untagged display

acceptance.requirement: Native normal/long paragraphs fit without clipping at 960x480; empty state returns to clock and voice remains primary
acceptance.method: Inspect native PNGs and run layout overflow rejection

acceptance.requirement: Reject malformed/private/stale/wrong-scope/replayed input, atomically apply fresh revisions, expire last good, and preserve manual choices
acceptance.method: Focused native/race and isolated Linux tests

acceptance.requirement: Verify physical readability and live reload/expiry while respecting real manual settings
acceptance.method: Commissioning owner observes target after authorized installation

evidence.method: Native Linux test renderer exported PNGs; presentation agent inspected all four local images at 960x480
evidence.limits: Synthetic local render only; no target panel/brightness/viewing-distance observation
evidence.covers: Normal/long text fit, empty clock fallback, upstream voice foreground

evidence.method: Host race tests, isolated Linux native tests and untagged clock regression; Linux amd64/ARMv7 compile checks
evidence.limits: No physical input/audio test, live Orbit writer or target reload; file lifecycle test uses an injected unprivileged reader
evidence.observer: presentation agent; Linux execution relayed by commissioning owner
evidence.covers: Privacy/scope/freshness/revision and atomic persistence boundaries, foreground/manual choices, palette preservation
evidence.target: Go store, feature lifecycle and native display

handoff.lastVerifiedResult: Six context tests pass with host race detection and on isolated Linux; three tagged native display tests and upstream clock regression pass. All four native 960x480 PNGs inspected without clipping/overlap. ARMv7 compile passes; target remains unverified.
unresolved: Trusted operator transport and enrollment not connected
handoff.reopenWhen: A trusted operator writer and authorized target commissioning are ready for live rendering/reload/expiry and manual-control checks
handoff.rollback: Select another clock style or remove operator binding; remove isolated patch for source rollback.
